column1: # Linking verbs other than essere: what follows them says what the subject
# is, seems or becomes (sembra stanco, è diventata medico, pare un sogno), a
# subject complement, never an object. The verbs here get `linking=yes`, the
# rest `linking=no`, and the grammar's linking-verb rules (cop.verb,
# cop.perfect, vp.copula-lo-nonfinite, vp.copula-infinitive-adjective,
# vp.copula-nonfinite-noun…) take the verbs with `linking=yes`. essere keeps
# rules of its own (cop.essere, cop.perfect-essere): its participle after it
# is a compound tense, theirs is not.
# stare takes an adjective (sta zitto, stare zitti) but, as an infinitive or
# gerund, no noun phrase and no predicate lo: those rules leave it out by
# lemma.
# All of these are intransitive: data/it/intransitive-verbs.tsv lists them,
# so a noun phrase after them is never a direct object (vp.object).
# One verb per line, as the infinitive. ridivenire is left out: the sentence
# sets' lexicon answers have no form of it.
apparire
diventare
divenire
parere
restare
ridiventare
